judged_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6:11 — `model.findMembers()` is fired without awaiting/blocking `setupController`/`afterModel` (unlike the old `afterModel` promise chain that populated `_members` before `setupController` ran), so the route resolves and renders before the members are fetched; there is no loading/spinner state and no error handler, meaning a failed `findMembers` request (e.g., permission-denied via `guardian.ensure_can_see!`) leaves the page silently showing zero members with no indication anything went wrong.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6`, the old `afterModel` returned the `model.findMembers()` promise, so a failed AJAX (e.g. 403 from `guardian.ensure_can_see!` in `GroupsController#members`) would reject the transition and flow through Ember route error handling. The new code calls `model.findMembers();` inside `setupController` and does not return/await it, so the transition completes and the template can render before `members` is populated (now filled asynchronously via `Discourse.Group#findMembers` setting `members`), and failures are no longer tied to the route lifecycle (no `.catch`, no error substate), leading to a silent empty members display.
